description.value:
Frequency your Intelligence modifier times per day, minimum once

Trigger A Signal-declared effect of yours fails

Traits Paradise-Touched

You take double the force damage the failure would deal and gain no Signal Drift from it. Double means double whatever your Signal failure damage currently is: 4 force damage per level normally, or 6 per level if you have Signal Mastery. The damage cannot be reduced or avoided by any means, and the Drift point is avoided entirely rather than delayed.

cinderfall.incomplete: Free reaction: on a Signal failure, take double the force damage and waive the Drift point. Self-damage-modification triggered by the resolving effect's own degree of success has no rule-element home. The class's Signal/Static core mechanic has no rule-element analog anywhere in pf2e-source: `AdjustDegreeOfSuccess` evaluates in `beforePrepareData`, before the roll resolves, so it cannot hook a GM's own secret post-roll check or show the player a value other than what was actually computed (`pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/adjust-degree-of-success.ts`); self-inflicted reactive damage/resource cost keyed to the resolving effect's own degree of success has no rule-element home; and no `Reroll` rule-element key exists anywhere in the compendium (`pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/human/level-1/courteous-comeback.json` ships `rules: []`). The Drift waiver additionally rests on the unbuildable Drift track. The 0-10 Signal Drift track has the same absence as Bandwidth: no `SpecialResource`/counter representation anywhere in the corpus.
